```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)      # to do datascience
library(here)           # to work easily with paths
library(DT)             # to make interactive tables
options(DT.options = list(
  bPaginate = TRUE # to allow pagination. Default is FALSE
))
```

```{r load_data, include=FALSE}
cray_df <- readr::read_tsv(
  here::here("data", "output", "20250224_craywatch_cleaned.txt"),
  na = "",
  guess_max = 10000
)
```

## Row

### Explore the data
    
```{r}
DT::datatable(cray_df)
```
